notes: GAAP report (accrual government-wide, modified accrual funds), aligned with FY2023/FY2024 choices. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); roll-forward 1,749,942 + 1,962,569 - 2,359,431 - 14,726 = 1,338,354 ties. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p7): receipts total = total operating revenues 634,307 + interest income 893 (computed); disbursements total 627,567 as printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 597,859 + interest 29,108 + bond issuance costs 600; roll-forward 1,665,023 + 635,200 - 627,567 + 14,726 = 1,687,382 ties. Utility 'Other revenue' 1,878 kept in charges for services because the Statement of Activities counts total operating revenues 634,307 as Charges for Services. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash and cash equivalents 921,111 (p4); certificates of deposit 256,605 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 132,965 (p4) is a separate printed line not added. Beginning governmental cash not printed. Government-wide-only items (Transfer to City from CRA 6,639, p3) are not in the fund statements. General Fund detail from the departmental combining schedule (pp14-15, ties to the statement General column; department functions follow the statement: Medical Clinic in General government, Cemetery in Public works); the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10, budget basis) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Street and LB840 budget schedules (pp11-12, budget basis) recorded; the Street 'Transfers from other funds' line (budget 115,000, actual -) not recorded; LB840 budget '-' recorded as 0. Nonmajor Lottery and CDBG from the combining statement (p13). No business-type detail lines (as FY2023/FY2024). Component unit (CRA) excluded. Balance sheet: Land business-type 202,598 on the Statement of Net Position vs 202,599 on the proprietary statement (p6) (rounding; SoNP figure used). Read pages 1-15 of 15
